### [`unused_e7e8`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_e7e8.asm#L6) `$E7E8-$E7FF`

*data*

24 bytes after the 1000 colour bytes of the stored arena. Nothing reads them. As in $e400-$e7e7, the low nibbles are colours and the high nibbles are irregular, as a CPU read of the colour RAM $d800-$dbff gives.
